title: Northbridge Appeals Packages: Schedule of Internal Review Levels
content:
Each member's Member Appeals Program runs under the Northbridge Appeals package that the member's plan sponsor elected. This schedule sets out, package by package, how many internal appeal levels there are before the internal process is exhausted and which party decides each level.

## Availability

Every package is available only as a package the plan sponsor has elected, and no package is available to a grandfathered plan. The funding arrangement for which each package is available is shown in the first column of the schedule below.

## Schedule

| Package | Funding arrangement | Internal appeal levels | First level decided by | Second level decided by | Second-level filing limit (calendar days after the first-level decision) | Case file sent to the plan sponsor (business days) | Plan sponsor's decision period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Appeals Level One Delegated | Self-funded | 2 | Northbridge | Plan sponsor | 60 | 2 | 15 |
| Northbridge Appeals Two-Level Delegated | Self-funded | 2 | Northbridge | Northbridge | 60 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Appeals Single-Level with External Review | Self-funded | 1 | Northbridge | Not applicable (single level) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Appeals Two-Level with External Review | Self-funded | 2 | Northbridge | Northbridge | 60 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured | Fully insured | 1 | Northbridge | Not applicable (single level) | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Northbridge Appeals Full Fiduciary Delegation | Self-funded | 2 | Northbridge | Northbridge | 60 | 0 | 0 |

Notes to the schedule:

1. The second-level filing limit is counted in calendar days with the first-level decision date as day zero. A figure of 0 means the package has a single internal level.
2. Where the plan sponsor decides the second level, the sponsor keeps final fiduciary authority. The case-file period is in business days and the sponsor's decision period is in calendar days. A figure of 0 in either column means Northbridge decides the second level.
3. Under all six packages, each level is decided by a reviewer who decided no earlier level and is not subordinate to anyone who did.
4. Under all six packages, an appeal of a clinical denial is decided by a clinical peer who took no part in the original denial.

## Reading the schedule

- **Same number of levels, different second-level decider.** Northbridge Appeals Level One Delegated and Northbridge Appeals Two-Level Delegated both have 2 internal levels. Under Level One Delegated the plan sponsor decides the second level: the case file goes to the sponsor within 2 business days and the sponsor decides within 15 calendar days. Under Two-Level Delegated, Northbridge decides both levels.
- **Single-level packages.** Northbridge Appeals Single-Level with External Review and Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured have 1 internal level. The second-level columns therefore show "not applicable" or 0.
- **Fully insured plans.** Of the six packages, only Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured is available to a fully insured plan.
